// diagnostic E0336

Jet.PatchableGenericStruct

`#Patchable` on a generic struct

What

`#Patchable` on a generic struct

Why

A patch type is built from a concrete field list, which a generic struct doesn't have yet

Fix

Remove `#Patchable` from the generic struct or make the struct non-generic.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.PatchableGenericStruct: Tests/UI/patchable_generic.stderr.

Error: Jet.PatchableGenericStruct: `#[Patchable]` on generic struct `Box` isn't supported yet
  --> Tests/UI/patchable_generic.jet:2:1
    |
  2 | Box: struct<T> {
    | ^^^
 Why: `T.Patch` codegen needs a concrete field list — generic patches are a follow-on
 Fix: Remove the type parameters, or drop `#[Patchable]` for now
